method: Isolated workers; six warmups, fifteen warm in-memory links per cell. Both source inputs are printer-normalized and comment-free. Output hashes use optimized JS, C and direct wasm. Worker RSS includes input snapshots and frontend warmups, sampled before importing backends or emitting. Token counts exclude comments and include imports, summed per file. Cells run sequentially; timings are exploratory, not a paired interleaved performance claim.
